metadata.title: fix: implement permission-based menu hiding in admin UI
metadata.author: vishu-bh

description:
## Summary

Implements permission-based menu hiding in the admin UI to fix UX bug where users see inaccessible menu items that return 403 errors when clicked.

## Changes

### Core Implementation
- **mcpgateway/admin.py**:
  - Added `SECTION_PERMISSIONS` mapping (24 sections → required permissions)
  - Implemented `get_hidden_sections_for_user()` helper function
  - Integrated permission-based hiding into `admin_ui()` function
  - Fail-closed security: errors hide sections

### Template Updates
- **mcpgateway/templates/admin.html**:
  - Removed redundant `is_admin` checks from 9 locations
  - Simplified template logic to rely on server-side permission checks

### Testing
- **tests/unit/mcpgateway/test_admin_menu_visibility.py**:
  - 9 comprehensive unit tests (all passing)
  - Tests platform admin bypass, team admin, developer, viewer roles
  - Tests fail-closed behavior on permission check errors

- **tests/playwright/test_admin_menu_visibility.py**:
  - 6 E2E integration tests (all passing)
  - Real user/team/role setup via REST API
  - Validates no 403 errors on accessible menu items
  - Module-scoped fixtures for efficient execution

## Security Model

Two-layer security:
1. **Token Scoping (Layer 1)**: Controls what resources a user CAN SEE
2. **RBAC (Layer 2)**: Controls what actions a user CAN DO

Platform admins with unrestricted tokens (`teams: null`) bypass permission checks.

## Test Results

### Unit Tests
```
9 passed in 0.15s
```

### Integration Tests
```
6 passed, 6 warnings in 18.60s
```

## Closes

Closes #3554

- [x] Unit tests added and passing
- [x] Integration tests added and passing
- [x] Security model documented
- [x] Fail-closed behavior implemented
- [x] DCO sign-off included
